description.narrative: The objective for the basket fund was to finance important analytical work on public finance management to identify both progress and weaknesses and thus help the government and development partners to design and prioritise further PFM reform.

Genom korgfonden för studier om de offentliga finanserna och den offentliga finansiella styrningen (s.k. Public Expenditure Reviews, PER) kommer Sverige bidra till att angelägna studier genomförs och att väl underbyggda reformer och förbättringar kan implementeras. Urvalet av PER-studier görs genom en deltagande process som involverar seniora tjänstemän i den tanzaniska statsaparaten såväl som representanter för civilsamhället, privatsektorn, biståndsgivare och en tanzanisk tankesmedja. Insatsen är komplementär till det svenska budgetstödet till Tanzania.

Through the Public Expenditure Review (PER) Basket Fund, Sweden will contribution to critical studies being carried out and that well informed reforms can be implemented. The selection of PER studies is done through a participatory process involving senior government officials as well as representatives from the civil society, private sector, donors and a Tanzanian think-tank. The initiative is complementary to the Swedish budget support operation.

Only two activities were financed through the basket fund i) a Public investment management operational manual training with a budget of 184 448 USD and ii) Private public partnership study with a planned budgeted of 324 475 USD. The last activity of the basket fund was carried out in June 2016
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
